title: Should Dividend Stock Investors Buy AT&T Stock? | T Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garbled in places (fair value figure unclear)
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc revisits AT&T (T) as SpaceX invests aggressively in satellite networks, asking whether the stock is still a buy for dividend investors. Analysts expect 10%+ earnings-per-share growth over the next several years, but he is less optimistic: the wireless market is saturated, so growth must come from revenue per user and productivity rather than new customers, though AT&T has lifted its operating margin from 16% to over 21.6% over the past decade, partly using AI. The balance sheet is the big constraint, with over $178B in long-term debt, and the coming 5G-to-6G build-out will be expensive at higher interest rates. The valuation has compressed to a forward P/E of about 8.4, down from over 12 and near the cheapest since 2024. He trims his free-cash-flow estimates by under 1% from 2028 and raises his risk estimate as SpaceX competition grows, but still calculates a fair value implying roughly 22% upside versus the $21.75 current price. Call: T BUY (reiterated), with conviction downgraded from medium to low.
